public.title: Maximum Depth of Binary Tree
public.description: Return the maximum number of nodes on a path from the root to a leaf. Empty trees have depth zero. Trees use compact breadth-first arrays: read the root, then left and right child slots for each non-null node in queue order. null marks a missing child; absent trailing slots are null. [] is empty. Values are integers from -10000 to 10000 and there are at most 200 nodes.
hints: An empty subtree contributes depth zero.
Add one to the deeper child subtree.
public.attribution: Original statement, examples, tests and solutions authored for Bekor, 2026, for a standard algorithmic problem. No third-party exercise text or solution code used.

explanation: Compute one plus the maximum child depth recursively. O(n) time and O(h) traversal stack.
